title: Holy Trinity Church interior
description: The interior of the Anglican Church is accessed through the narthex at the base of the tower and belfry, leading into a spacious nave. The nave features wainscoting along the perimeter and decorative panel framing, rising from the wainscoting to the roof, accented by rich oak moldings. A central aisle runs toward the east wall, flanked by butternut pews on either side. The chancel, raised three steps above the nave, provides seating for the choir and houses the altar. Large, stained-glass, dedicated pointed-arch windows adorn both the east and west walls.
